title: astragalus cicer var. microphyllus
intro: Astragalus cicer var. microphyllus, commonly known as small-leaf milk vetch, is a type of perennial legume that belongs to the Astragalus genus. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can aid in reducing stress, improving sleep, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus cicer var. microphyllus include its ability to stimulate the production of white blood cells, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
